name: Office of the City Mayor
description: Executive branch of the Zamboanga City Government responsible for overall administration, governance, and strategic direction of city policies and programs.
vision: The role model in the delivery of fast, reliable and efficient public service utilizing the full benefits of information technology, proactive to the needs of the people, vigorously promoting development under a transparent and actively preserving a strong and united Zamboanga

contactInformation.address: 2nd Floor, City Hall, NS Valderosa St., Zone IV, Zamboanga City

name: Office of the City Administrator
description: Integrates and coordinates the operational work of all departments, offices, and administrative units of the Zamboanga City Government.

name: Office of the City Accountant
description: Manages city accounting, financial reporting, internal auditing, and maintains municipal financial records to ensure fiscal transparency.

name: Office of the City Assessor
description: Responsible for the appraisal and assessment of real properties (land, buildings, machinery) for taxation purposes in Zamboanga City.

name: Office of the City Treasurer
description: Custodian of municipal funds, handles local tax collection, revenue management, license processing, and disbursement of city funds.

name: Office of the City Engineer
description: Plans, designs, constructs, and maintains city infrastructure, public works, bridges, roads, and municipal physical facilities.

name: Office of the City Legal
description: Serves as chief legal counsel to the City Government, providing legal opinions, drafting contracts, and representing the city in court litigation.

name: General Services Office
description: Manages procurement of goods and services, maintenance of city properties, custodianship of municipal assets, and general administrative support.

name: Office of the City Budget
description: Formulates, evaluates, and executes the annual executive budget, fiscal plans, and budgetary allocations of Zamboanga City.

name: Office of the City Planning and Development
description: Formulates comprehensive land use plans, socio-economic development strategies, zoning guidelines, and spatial development policies.

name: Office of the City Health
description: Delivers primary healthcare services, public health campaigns, disease prevention, sanitation supervision, and health center management across all barangays.

name: Office of the City Social Welfare and Development
description: Provides social protection programs, child and youth welfare assistance, senior citizen benefits, crisis intervention, and family development services.

name: Office of the City Veterinarian
description: Oversees animal disease prevention, anti-rabies vaccination drives, livestock safety regulation, public slaughterhouse operations, and animal welfare.

name: Office of the City Agriculturist
description: Promotes agricultural productivity, fishery resources management, farmer assistance, crop protection, and food security initiatives in rural barangays.

name: Office of the City Civil Registrar
description: Registers vital civil events (birth, marriage, death), maintains civil register archives, and issues official certified documents for residents.

name: Office of the City Environment and Natural Resources
description: Leads solid waste management, environmental protection, urban forestry, coastal ecosystem conservation, and climate change adaptation initiatives.

name: Colegio De La Ciudad De Zamboanga
description: Local tertiary educational institution operated by the Zamboanga City Government offering technical-vocational and higher degree programs.

name: Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlungsod
description: Provides administrative and technical support to the city council, keeps council records, prepares session agendas, and archives approved ordinances.

name: Sangguniang Panlungsod
description: The unicameral legislative body of Zamboanga City responsible for enacting local ordinances, passing resolutions, and approving the annual budget.

name: Office of the City Disaster Risk Reduction Management
description: Directs disaster risk prevention, mitigation, early warning systems, search and rescue operations, and community disaster preparedness.

name: City Human Resource Management Office
description: Manages personnel recruitment, civil service compliance, employee welfare, capacity building, performance evaluation, and organizational development.

name: CMO – Gender and Development Services (GAD)
description: Special division under the Mayor's Office dedicated to gender mainstreaming, women empowerment initiatives, and gender-responsive public policy.

name: CMO – Local Economic Development and Investment Promotion Services (LEDIPS)
description: Special division under the Mayor's Office focused on business investment attraction, local economic growth, trade promotion, and enterprise support.
